description: Generate random personal names typical of one or more countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Output is synthetic: for fiction, placeholders and test data. Not for impersonation or identity verification. On the paid remote server: pass a prepaid 'token' (from buy_pack) to get names directly; without a token it returns the price and the exact URL to pay via x402 (USDC). Each region requested costs 1 credit or the per-region minimum price.

pay.description: Optional USDC amount above the minimum (per-request payment only)

region.description: One code (AR) or up to 13 comma-separated (AR,MX,BR). Supported: AR,BR,CN,DE,ES,FR,GB,IN,IT,JP,MX,NG,US

seed.description: Optional; same seed gives same names

name: generate_names
